"""Exact four-case C157964 Native capture; --check never contacts CARLA."""

import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
import json
from pathlib import Path

from officer_camera import CAMERAS, CAMERA_SIZES
from officer_construction import spawn_officer_performer
from officer_direction import PREFIX, SUFFIXES, native_bone_adapter
from officer_native_capture import NativeOfficerCapture
from officer_site import SITE, validate_site


ASSIGNMENT = PREFIX[:-2]
CASES = {PREFIX + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES}


def validate_config(config):
    site = validate_site()
    if (config.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or
            (config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) !=
            ("NRS-484B-257-1", "C157964", "motor_vehicle_driver") or
            config.get("selected_case_id") not in CASES):
        raise ValueError("Exact C157964 officer case identity required")
    if (config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("duration_s")) != (20, 30):
        raise ValueError("Officer original capture requires 20 Hz and 30 seconds")
    if config.get("site", {}).get("xodr_sha256") != site["site_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Officer config differs from authored junction")
    if config.get("site", {}).get("native_map_id") != "OpenDriveMap":
        raise ValueError("Native OpenDRIVE map identity required")
    if (config["site"].get("ego_lane") != [site["ego_road_id"], site["ego_lane_id"]] or
            config["site"].get("through_lane") not in site["through_approaches"]):
        raise ValueError("Officer configuration misses authored ego or through approach")
    cameras = config.get("cameras")
    if (not isinstance(cameras, list) or [item.get("name") for item in cameras] != list(CAMERAS) or
            any((item.get("width"), item.get("height")) != CAMERA_SIZES[item["name"]] or
                item.get("fov_deg") != 90 for item in cameras)):
        raise ValueError("Four original officer cameras differ from capture profile")
    if (not isinstance(config.get("required_atoms"), list) or
            set(config.get("camera_mounts", {})) != set(CAMERAS) or
            any(not isinstance(mount, dict) or set(mount) != {"pose", "attach_to"} or
                mount["attach_to"] not in (None, "ego", "through", "officer")
                for mount in config["camera_mounts"].values())):
        raise ValueError("Officer camera mounts or Core observation contract missing")
    for role in ("ego", "through", "officer"):
        pose = config.get("actor_transforms", {}).get(role)
        if (not isinstance(pose, dict) or set(pose) != {"location", "rotation"} or
                set(pose["location"]) != {"x", "y", "z"} or
                set(pose["rotation"]) != {"yaw", "pitch", "roll"}):
            raise ValueError("Explicit officer-case Native actor transform required: " + role)
    if (set(config.get("actor_blueprints", {})) != {"ego", "through", "officer"} or
            not all(config["actor_blueprints"].values()) or
            not isinstance(config.get("officer_pose", {}).get("stop"), dict) or
            not isinstance(config["officer_pose"].get("go"), dict) or
            not isinstance(config.get("officer_context"), dict) or
            config["officer_context"].get("junction_source") != "officer-site.xodr#157961" or
            config["officer_context"].get("intersection_id") != 157961 or
            config["officer_context"].get("native_map_id") != "OpenDriveMap"):
        raise ValueError("Exact officer performer, poses or sourced junction context missing")
    for role in ("ego", "through"):
        control = config.get("drive", {}).get(role)
        if (not isinstance(control, dict) or set(control) != {"throttle", "brake", "steer"} or
                any(type(value) not in (int, float) for value in control.values())):
            raise ValueError("Explicit per-tick Native vehicle control required: " + role)
    return config


def _transform(carla, pose):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(**pose["location"]),
                           carla.Rotation(**pose["rotation"]))


def capture(config, output_dir, host, port):
    import carla
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    output = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or not (output / "construction.json").is_file():
        raise ValueError("Materialize exact officer construction before Native capture")
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(30)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    failure = None
    summary = None
    try:
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(SITE.read_text())
        if world.get_map().name != config["site"]["native_map_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Generated officer map differs from configuration")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / config["rate_hz"]
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        blueprints = {}
        for role, blueprint_id in config["actor_blueprints"].items():
            blueprint = library.find(blueprint_id)
            blueprint.set_attribute("role_name", "c157964_" + role)
            blueprints[role] = blueprint
        camera_blueprints = {}
        for item in config["cameras"]:
            blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            for key, value in (("image_size_x", item["width"]),
                               ("image_size_y", item["height"]), ("fov", item["fov_deg"])):
                blueprint.set_attribute(key, str(value))
            camera_blueprints[item["name"]] = blueprint
        mounts = {name: {"transform": _transform(carla, value["pose"]),
                         "attach_to": value["attach_to"]}
                  for name, value in config["camera_mounts"].items()}
        transforms = {name: _transform(carla, pose)
                      for name, pose in config["actor_transforms"].items()}
        for role in ("ego", "through"):
            waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint(transforms[role].location)
            expected = config["site"][role + "_lane"]
            if waypoint is None or [waypoint.road_id, waypoint.lane_id] != expected:
                raise ValueError("Native vehicle pose misses selected approach lane: " + role)
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            actors = {}
            for role in ("ego", "through"):
                actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprints[role], transforms[role])
                if actor is None:
                    raise ValueError("Native officer-case vehicle spawn failed: " + role)
                stack.callback(actor.destroy)
                actors[role] = actor
            case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
            if not case_id.endswith("__no_officer_yield_nearest_view"):
                officer = stack.enter_context(spawn_officer_performer(
                    world, blueprints["officer"], transforms["officer"],
                    carla.Location(**config["junction_center_xyz_m"])))
                actors["officer"] = officer["actor"]
            context = dict(config["officer_context"], case_id=case_id,
                           officer_actor_id=getattr(actors.get("officer"), "id", None),
                           through_actor_id=actors["through"].id)
            if "officer" not in actors:
                context.update(authority_source=None, uniform_video_source=None)
            adapter = native_bone_adapter(carla, config["officer_pose"]["stop"],
                                          config["officer_pose"]["go"])
            frames = config["rate_hz"] * config["duration_s"]
            with NativeOfficerCapture(world, client, output, case_id, actors, context,
                                      camera_blueprints, mounts, config["required_atoms"],
                                      adapter, frames) as session:
                for index in range(frames):
                    for role in ("ego", "through"):
                        drive = config["drive"][role]
                        actors[role].apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(**drive))
                    session.capture_tick()
            summary = {"source_frames": session.count,
                       "encoder_exit_codes": session.encoder.exit_codes}
    except Exception as error:
        failure = error
    try:
        restored = restore(client, saved)
    except Exception as error:
        (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "case_id": config["selected_case_id"], "capture_sealed": False,
            "errors": [*([str(failure)] if failure else []),
                       "World restoration failed: " + str(error)]}) + "\n")
        raise
    if failure is not None:
        (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "case_id": config["selected_case_id"], "capture_sealed": False,
            "errors": [str(failure)]}) + "\n")
        raise failure
    seal_capture(output, frames=summary["source_frames"], restoration=restored,
                 errors=[], encoder_exit_codes=summary["encoder_exit_codes"],
                 context={"selected_case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
                          "police_authority_and_camera_review_pending": True})


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = validate_config(json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text()))
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
                          "cpu_config_checked": True, "simulation_started": False}))
        return
    if not args.output_dir:
        raise ValueError("Native officer capture requires --output-dir")
    capture(config, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Capture-time officer and ego sources without prelabeling camera observations.

The caller owns four original camera encoders and the Native actors. This writer
records synchronized identities and programmed pose readback. A later human or
independent pixel review writes officer_review.json bound to these files and
the four encoded camera bytes. It never infers observed direction from a pose.
"""

import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
PREFIX = "testing__C157964__NRS-484B-257-1__motor_vehicle_driver__"
ACTIVE = {PREFIX + "officer_active_stop_then_go", PREFIX + "officer_active_hold"}
INACTIVE = PREFIX + "officer_present_inactive"
ABSENT = PREFIX + "no_officer_yield_nearest_view"


def _finite(value, name):
    if type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("Missing finite Native " + name)
    return float(value)


class OfficerSourceWriter:
    def __init__(self, root, context, frame_map_factory=None):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.context = dict(context)
        self.frame_map_factory = frame_map_factory
        self.frame_map = None
        self.history = None
        self.count = 0
        case_id = self.context.get("case_id")
        if case_id not in ACTIVE | {INACTIVE, ABSENT}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown exact officer case")
        if case_id == ABSENT:
            if self.context.get("officer_actor_id") is not None:
                raise ValueError("No-officer capture has an officer identity")
        elif type(self.context.get("officer_actor_id")) is not int:
            raise ValueError("Native officer actor identity missing")

    def __enter__(self):
        if self.frame_map_factory is None:
            from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
            self.frame_map_factory = FrameMap
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with (self.root / "officer_context.json").open("x") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(self.context, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        self.frame_map = self.frame_map_factory(self.root / "video_frames.jsonl")
        self.history = (self.root / "officer_history.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1)
        return self

    def add_tick(self, snapshot, cameras, ego, officer, programmed_pose, through=None):
        if self.frame_map is None or self.history is None:
            raise ValueError("Officer source writer is not open")
        frame = snapshot.frame
        time_s = _finite(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds, "time")
        if type(frame) is not int or set(cameras) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("Four original camera packets and frame required")
        for name in CAMERAS:
            packet = cameras[name]
            if packet.frame != frame or abs(_finite(packet.timestamp, name + " time") - time_s) > 1e-3:
                raise ValueError("Stale original officer camera packet: " + name)
        expected_id = self.context.get("officer_actor_id")
        if (getattr(officer, "id", None) if officer is not None else None) != expected_id:
            raise ValueError("Original officer actor differs from source context")
        if (programmed_pose.get("frame_index") != self.count or
                programmed_pose.get("officer_actor_id") != expected_id):
            raise ValueError("Programmed officer pose and original frame differ")
        command = programmed_pose.get("programmed_direction")
        applied = programmed_pose.get("pose_applied")
        active = self.context["case_id"] in ACTIVE
        if (type(applied) is not bool or
                (active and (command not in ("stop", "go") or not applied or
                             not programmed_pose.get("realized_bones"))) or
                (not active and (command != "none" or applied))):
            raise ValueError("Native officer pose differs from exact case program")
        vertices = ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(ego.get_transform())
        if len(vertices) < 8:
            raise ValueError("Complete original ego body vertices required")
        body = [[_finite(vertex.x, "ego body x"), _finite(vertex.y, "ego body y")]
                for vertex in vertices]
        velocity = ego.get_velocity()
        speed = math.sqrt(sum(_finite(getattr(velocity, axis), "ego velocity") ** 2
                              for axis in ("x", "y", "z")))
        row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "officer_actor_id": expected_id,
               "programmed_direction": command,
               "native_pose_applied": applied,
               "ego": {"speed_mps": speed, "body_vertices_xy_m": body}}
        through_id = self.context.get("through_actor_id")
        if through_id is not None:
            if through is None or getattr(through, "id", None) != through_id:
                raise ValueError("Original through actor differs from source context")
            through_vertices = through.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(through.get_transform())
            if len(through_vertices) < 8:
                raise ValueError("Complete original through body vertices required")
            through_velocity = through.get_velocity()
            row["through"] = {
                "actor_id": through_id,
                "speed_mps": math.sqrt(sum(_finite(getattr(through_velocity, axis),
                                                  "through velocity") ** 2
                                           for axis in ("x", "y", "z"))),
                "body_vertices_xy_m": [[_finite(vertex.x, "through body x"),
                                        _finite(vertex.y, "through body y")]
                                       for vertex in through_vertices]}
        if programmed_pose.get("realized_bones"):
            row["realized_bones"] = programmed_pose["realized_bones"]
        self.frame_map.append(frame, time_s,
                              camera_frames={name: cameras[name].frame for name in CAMERAS})
        self.history.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        self.count += 1
        return row

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        try:
            if self.history is not None:
                self.history.close()
        finally:
            if self.frame_map is not None:
                self.frame_map.close()

"""Validate the authored one-way to two-way officer junction before Native use."""

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


SITE = Path(__file__).with_name("officer-site.xodr")
EGO_ROAD = 157960
JUNCTION = 157961
THROUGH_SOUTH = 157964
THROUGH_NORTH = 157966
YIELD_SIGN = "1579601"


def validate_site(path=SITE):
    path = Path(path)
    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    if root.tag != "OpenDRIVE":
        raise ValueError("Officer site is not OpenDRIVE")
    roads = {int(road.get("id")): road for road in root.findall("road")}
    if set(roads) != {157960, 157962, 157963, 157964, 157965, 157966}:
        raise ValueError("Officer junction road inventory differs")
    if root.findall("controller") or root.findall(".//junction/controller"):
        raise ValueError("Officer-control site contains a signal controller")
    junctions = root.findall("junction")
    if len(junctions) != 1 or junctions[0].get("id") != str(JUNCTION):
        raise ValueError("Officer junction identity differs")
    connections = {(int(c.get("incomingRoad")), int(c.get("connectingRoad")))
                   for c in junctions[0].findall("connection")}
    if connections != {(EGO_ROAD, 157962), (THROUGH_SOUTH, 157965),
                       (THROUGH_NORTH, 157965)}:
        raise ValueError("Officer ego or through routes are disconnected")
    ego = roads[EGO_ROAD]
    ego_lanes = ego.findall("./lanes/laneSection/right/lane")
    if (len(ego_lanes) != 1 or ego_lanes[0].get("id") != "-1" or
            ego_lanes[0].get("type") != "driving" or
            ego.findall("./lanes/laneSection/left/lane")):
        raise ValueError("Officer ego approach is not one-way")
    signs = root.findall(".//signals/signal")
    if (len(signs) != 1 or signs[0].get("id") != YIELD_SIGN or
            signs[0].get("type") != "205" or signs[0].get("dynamic") != "no" or
            signs[0].find("validity").get("fromLane") != "-1" or
            signs[0].find("validity").get("toLane") != "-1"):
        raise ValueError("Officer junction lacks the signed ego entrance")
    for road_id in (THROUGH_SOUTH, THROUGH_NORTH):
        road = roads[road_id]
        left = road.findall("./lanes/laneSection/left/lane")
        right = road.findall("./lanes/laneSection/right/lane")
        if (len(left) != 1 or len(right) != 1 or left[0].get("id") != "1" or
                right[0].get("id") != "-1" or
                left[0].get("type") != "driving" or right[0].get("type") != "driving"):
            raise ValueError("Through highway lacks both opposing approaches")
    return {"site_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "ego_road_id": EGO_ROAD, "ego_lane_id": -1,
            "through_approaches": [[THROUGH_SOUTH, -1], [THROUGH_NORTH, 1]],
            "junction_id": JUNCTION, "yield_sign_id": YIELD_SIGN,
            "signal_controller_present": False,
            "physical_sign_and_view_status": "unverified"}
